purpose: Run Blueprint's real policy-to-WAM-to-same-policy loop with the frozen Cosmos3-Edge DROID policy while keeping skeleton-only, OSCAR, and native Cosmos WAM evidence separately attributable.

action_contract.policy_output_semantics: absolute Franka joint positions 7D plus explicit gripper 1D
action_contract.view_composition_for_policy_only: wrist full-width top; exterior 1 bottom-left; exterior 2 bottom-right
action_contract.wam_generation_rule: generate each calibrated camera view independently with the same frozen WAM arm; compose only when querying the policy

stages.admission: focused tests pass for three-view policy observation, policy endpoint identity, policy action shape, WAM attribution, and no physical-future leakage
exact snapshot verified; stock empty server metadata rejected; identity-bound metadata verified; one [16,8] finite action chunk returned

stages.terminal: task terminal, reliability abstention, collapse abstention, or maximum horizon
stages.claim_ceiling: proves orchestration and observation compatibility only; no scientific WAM, ranking, transfer, or physical-success credit

stages.admission: backend-matched WAM conditioning-fidelity certificate passes with at least four seeds and recorded/no-motion/shuffled controls
stages.terminal: complete episode, reliability abstention, collapse abstention, or frozen maximum horizon
stages.claim_ceiling: whole-stack qualification on the tested data only; independent policy-rank confirmation still requires disjoint labels

stages.admission: vendor-native UMI conditioning certificate passes, then the exact DROID 8D joint-position policy to 10D ee-pose conversion is independently validated
stages.claim_ceiling: separate native Edge WAM evidence; never attributed to OSCAR

wam_arms.input: policy actions rendered with calibrated kinematics
first RGB frame plus camera-aligned skeleton video
first RGB frame plus verified native numeric action trajectory

forbidden: Policy-DROID used as the neutral WAM
A policy or WAM grading itself
Physical future frames used to re-query the policy
Evaluator calls before a complete or abstained episode exists

evaluator.claim_boundary: Evaluator scoring cannot erase WAM causal failure and already-unsealed data remains diagnostic only.

success_condition: The learned policy is re-queried from three WAM-predicted camera views and commanded state for a complete episode without collapse; the selected WAM passes causal controls; Blueprint's reliability gate abstains on unreliable outputs; and later policy ranking agrees with independently frozen disjoint physical outcomes.
failure_interpretation: A failed engineering smoke diagnoses adapter/runtime incompatibility. A causally failed WAM receives no WAM credit. Missing disjoint labels keeps rank confirmation inconclusive rather than converting generated behavior into physical evidence.
